options.description: Reply to Tuya-specific time synchronization requests: "1970" - Reply with seconds since 1970/01/01 (recommended, should stop the device from asking), "2000" - Reply with seconds since 2000/01/01 (use if the weekday is wrong with 1970), "off" - Don't reply (use if replying causes too much traffic). Default for this device: "off"
options.label: Time start
options.name: time_start

options.description: Calibrates the temperature value (absolute offset), takes into effect on next report of device.
options.label: Temperature calibration
options.name: temperature_calibration

options.description: Number of digits after decimal point for temperature, takes into effect on next report of device. This option can only decrease the precision, not increase it.
options.label: Temperature precision
options.name: temperature_precision

options.description: Calibrates the soil_moisture value (absolute offset), takes into effect on next report of device.
options.label: Soil moisture calibration
options.name: soil_moisture_calibration

options.description: Number of digits after decimal point for soil_moisture, takes into effect on next report of device. This option can only decrease the precision, not increase it.
options.label: Soil moisture precision
options.name: soil_moisture_precision

options.description: Sets the duration of the identification procedure in seconds (i.e., how long the device would flash).The value ranges from 1 to 30 seconds (default: 3).
options.label: Identify timeout
options.name: identify_timeout

definition.description: TRADFRI bulb E12/E14/E26/E27, color/white spectrum, globe, opal, 600 lm

features.description: Color temperature after cold power on of this light
features.label: Color temp startup
features.name: color_temp_startup

presets.description: Restore previous color_temp on cold power on
presets.name: previous

features.description: Color of this light in the CIE 1931 color space (x/y)
features.label: Color (X/Y)
features.name: color_xy

features.description: this setting can affect the "on_level", "current_level_startup" or "brightness" setting
features.label: Execute if off
features.name: execute_if_off

features.description: Defines the desired startup level for a device when it is supplied with power
features.label: Current level startup
features.name: current_level_startup

exposes.description: Triggers an effect on the light (e.g. make light blink for a few seconds)
exposes.label: Effect
exposes.name: effect

exposes.description: Controls the behavior when the device is powered on after power loss
exposes.label: Power-on behavior
exposes.name: power_on_behavior

features.description: Controls whether color and color temperature can be set while light is off
features.label: Execute if off
features.name: execute_if_off

options.description: Controls the transition time (in seconds) of on/off, brightness, color temperature (if applicable) and color (if applicable) changes. Defaults to `0` (no transition).
options.label: Transition
options.name: transition

options.description: Whether to unfreeze IKEA lights (that are known to be frozen) before issuing a command, false: no unfreeze support, true: unfreeze support (default true).
options.label: Unfreeze support
options.name: unfreeze_support

options.description: When enabled colors will be synced, e.g. if the light supports both color x/y and color temperature a conversion from color x/y to color temperature will be done when setting the x/y color (default true).
options.label: Color sync
options.name: color_sync

options.description: Sets the duration of the identification procedure in seconds (i.e., how long the device would flash).The value ranges from 1 to 30 seconds (default: 3).
options.label: Identify timeout
options.name: identify_timeout

options.description: State actions will also be published as 'action' when true (default false).
options.label: State action
options.name: state_action
